answer: Sybil defences should leak value. Every credential quietly decays unless its holder answers a surprise proof-of-custody probe: sign one question only a wallet with months of local history can settle, inside a two-hour window. Each challenge is seeded like a plume carried on a whisper of gossip, so no farm can pre-answer tomorrow. Clones drift silent; their copper-grade stakes get slashed and sold to live bidders, trimming the roster on its own.
